title: La Convenzione Europea del Paesaggio vent’anni dopo (2000-2020)
bookshelves: Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: In 2020, the Osservatorio regionale del paesaggio of the Regione del Veneto (Landscape Observatory of the Veneto Region) promoted an international conference to commemorate the 20th anniversary of the European Landscape Convention adopted by the Committee of Ministers of Culture and Environment of the Council of Europe. Adopting an interdisciplinary and comparative approach, this volume collects the outputs of critical thinking about the impact and effects of the European Landscape Convention on the social, environmental, juridical, architectural, archaeological and managerial spheres, and presents a wide selection of theoretical and research essays, critical remarks and case studies.
